cohort: 510 pregnant women attending antenatal (ANC) clinics in Hawassa town public health institutions, Ethiopia
finding: Age at first conception, urban residency, widowed marital status, parity, history of stillbirth, and previous cesarean section were independently associated with GDM in Ethiopian women.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was independently associated with GDM (AOR=1.86, P=0.01, 95% CI (1.13,2.66)).
